title: Private vehicles get temporary busway access from Nepa Q-Mart to Boni

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Private vehicles will be temporarily allowed to pass through the Edsa Busway from Nepa Q-Mart to Boni Avenue stations starting Monday, Nov. 2, Transportation Sec. Vince Dizon announced. Dizon said the arrangement would remain in effect for about two weeks, or until the road resurfacing along the stations under Phase 2 of the Edsa rehabilitation is completed. He said the temporary opening of the busway to private vehicles was intended to ease traffic and “lessen trouble for motorists.” READ: Rehabilitated Edsa Busway stations in QC, Caloocan reopen “While this is being done and the asphalting of the busway […]...
